title: CoveragePlanRequest
description: Input contract for AGENT-003 Coverage Planner. Contains the current state of the knowledge graph: registered artifacts, statement inventory, unknown register, and authority matrix.

entity_slug.description: The slug of the entity being planned for (e.g. 'msc-bellissima').

registered_artifact_ids.description: Artifact IDs already ingested. Used to avoid recommending re-acquisition.

statement_inventory.description: Counts of known vs unknown statements.

unknown_register.description: Every statement that is currently unresolved. Each entry identifies the predicate and subject.

authority_matrix.description: Mapping of document classes to the predicates they are capable of establishing.
